text_blocks.snippet: Common side effects of losartan include dizziness, fatigue, and cold symptoms, while rare serious risks involve high potassium levels and kidney damage.
These mild effects often improve as your body gets used to the medicine:
Get medical help right away if you notice these dangerous signs:

list.snippet: Angioedema: Swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat, which makes it hard to breathe.
High potassium: Muscle weakness, chest pain, or a fast heartbeat.
Kidney issues: Swelling in your hands or feet, or urinating less than usual.
Low blood pressure: Fainting or extreme lightheadedness.
Pregnancy: Do not take losartan if you are pregnant because it can cause serious injury or death to an unborn baby.
Monitoring: Your doctor will likely schedule regular blood tests to check your kidney function and potassium levels.
